name: CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Card

apr.notes: 21.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash (cash advances, balance transfers and CIBC Convenience Cheques) for non-Quebec residents, 21.99% for Quebec residents.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: 1 Aeroplan point per $1 on all other purchases.

categories.label: Gas, EV charging, groceries and Air Canada direct purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Aeroplan points redeem for Air Canada and partner flights and other Aeroplan rewards.

notes: Network tier is Visa Infinite per the card name. Bonus earn rates apply on the first $80,000 in net annual card purchases on the account.
